'''Bay 63''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located at the [[Betha II Starport]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crewed by a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] and two [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] used the bay.
